t_advice_summary_textbox.text: Basically the main objective to gather as many mushrooms as possible. The gnomes will be wearing different colors and vairations of hats. The way or position it is worn doesnt matter, only the color. There are 2 pairs of colors and the main objective is to pick the right color so it will take you to the correct tree.
